import random, sys, time, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/work')
import compiler
from harness import check_plan

random.seed(7)
N = 48
edges = set()
while len(edges) < 128:
    u = random.randrange(N); v = random.randrange(N)
    if u == v: continue
    key = (min(u, v), max(u, v))
    if key in edges: continue
    edges.add(key)
LINKS2 = [[u, v, 50] for u, v in sorted(edges)]
parts = sorted(random.sample(range(N), 32))
demands = {v: random.randrange(0, 5) for v in parts}
if sum(demands.values()) == 0: demands[parts[0]] = 3
envelope = {i: 8 for i in range(128)}
period = 7
caps = {i: period*8 for i in range(128)}
t0 = time.time()
plan = compiler._try_variant(N, [(u,v) for u,v,_ in LINKS2], envelope, period, parts, demands, 'relay', 0)
print('relay', 'plan' if plan else None, '%.2f' % (time.time()-t0))
if plan:
    ok, why = check_plan(plan, N, [(u, v) for u, v, _ in LINKS2], caps, parts, demands, period, envelope)
    print('valid', ok, why)
    print('routes', len(plan['routes']), 'recipes', len(plan['recipes']), 'trees', len(plan['trees']))
    print(json.dumps(plan['routes'][:5]))
    print(json.dumps(plan['recipes'][:10]))
PYEOF
